verdict: onsemi's earnings grew about four times faster than revenue, as AI data-center demand lifted power-chip sales and margins.

segments.name: Power Solutions Group
segments.note: Power chips (PSG) that manage electricity in cars, factories and AI data centers — the growth engine this quarter.

segments.name: Analog & Mixed-Signal Group
segments.note: Analog and mixed-signal chips (AMG) that connect sensors and systems to the digital world.

segments.name: Intelligent Sensing Group
segments.note: Image sensors (ISG) — camera chips for cars and machines.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next power and sensing chips.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling chips to carmakers, factories and cloud builders.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: The back office: finance, legal, HR and executives.

opex.name: Amortization of intangible assets
opex.note: Spreading the cost of technology bought in past acquisitions.

opex.name: Restructuring & impairments
opex.note: Fab-consolidation and restructuring charges — much smaller than earlier in 2026.

otherDetail: Interest income of $17M and other income of $18M, less $14M of interest expense — a net $21M boost.

takeaways.title: Power chips are carrying growth
takeaways.text: Power Solutions revenue rose 21% to $890M. AI data-center revenue grew 175% from a year ago, and onsemi raised its 2030 AI data-center target to over $3B.

takeaways.title: Margins expanded a fifth straight quarter
takeaways.text: GAAP gross margin reached 41.4%, up from 37.9% a year ago — richer power products and factory discipline turned 11% revenue growth into roughly 40% EPS growth.

takeaways.title: A cash machine while it invests
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $489M, 28% of revenue. Big announced deals (Ferric, and Synaptics on revised ~$5.7B cash terms) had not closed yet in the quarter.

oneTimers: Operating expenses include $4.6M of restructuring and asset-impairment charges — far less than the $41.2M last quarter and the heavy fab-consolidation charges earlier in 2026.
footerNote: Quarter ended Oct 2, 2026 (13-week quarter). Net income shown is before $0.5M NCI (attributable: $313.9M).
follow100Note: Figures are rounded to the nearest $M from the release's one-decimal figures and balance at that rounding.
